Name: CP - Expressive Wizard
Author: Syraye
Description:
Wizard portrait replacement for use with Content Patcher featuring all "dateable" character expressions.

I orginally developed this for my own use with the Romanceable Rasmodius mod as I felt the existing "handsome" wizard, portrait replacements felt a little too immersion breaking when used alongside the default sprites. My new wizard's design is based off of Sebastian's default portrait set and features a version with facial hair and without.

Version 2.0 is an updated version made in the style of my Expressive Elliott. 
Version 1.0 is  based off Sebastian's default sprites and features 10 expressions. ,I've also included an optional file that replaces Sebastian's default portrait sprites to add the wizard's hat and hair. 

[b]Recommended[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url]
